2.t: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.

3.t: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.

4.t: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.

5.t: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!

6.t: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,

7.t: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).

8.t: Lo! it is closed in on them
